text:
Your uploaded materials don't cover redox, so I'll teach this from general chemistry.

Start with the basics. In a redox reaction, electrons move from one species to another. Take a simple example: $\text{Zn} + \text{Cu}^{2+} \to \text{Zn}^{2+} + \text{Cu}$.

Which species loses electrons and which gains them, and how many electrons does each one move?
